name: Sline
definition: Sline is a method providing a smooth transition from silhouettes to detailed illustrative styles to Phong shading for surface meshes, achieving a transition from abstract representation to non-illustrative visualization without relying on textures or assumptions about underlying models.
summary: Sline is a surface-based illustrative rendering method that smoothly transitions between silhouettes and Phong shading without relying on texture coordinates or mesh topology assumptions.
